script: Much of the white sand on some tropical beaches is parrotfish poop. Parrotfish bite off chunks of coral and rock to eat the algae growing on them. They grind it up, and what comes out the other end is fine sand. A single large parrotfish can make hundreds of kilograms of sand each year. Some parrotfish sleep inside a bubble of mucus that they make every night. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
